# netris_vnet_ports

Attaches a declared set of switch ports to an existing V-Net — typically one
created by a Server Cluster template — without owning the V-Net. It is the
explicit "port binding" half of bare-metal onboarding: while a server is not
yet commissioned, its frontend switch ports are bound directly to the parking
V-Net by this resource; after commissioning, membership in a Server Cluster
(whose server↔port mapping comes from inventory links) programs the ports.

The merge is additive and scoped to the declared ports: every other member of
the V-Net — ports dynamically programmed via server cluster membership, or
ports declared by another configuration — is preserved untouched. Destroy
removes exactly the declared ports. Multiple configurations may each manage
their own `netris_vnet_ports` on the same V-Net as long as they do not declare
the same port; concurrent applies against one V-Net race (last PUT wins).

Read is an existence check only — out-of-band port changes are converged by
the next update or a taint/replace.

## Example Usages

```hcl
# Bind a not-yet-commissioned server's frontend ports to the parking V-Net
# (its ID comes from the parking system cluster's template instantiation).
resource "netris_vnet_ports" "parking" {
  vnet_id = 42

  ports {
    port     = "swp5@leaf-01"
    untagged = true
  }

  ports {
    port     = "swp5@leaf-02"
    untagged = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- **vnet_id** (Number) ID of the V-Net to bind ports to.

### Optional

- **ports** (Set of Object) Set of switch ports to bind to the V-Net. Multiple ports from different switches form an EVPN multihoming group automatically. (see below for nested schema)

### Nested Schema for `ports`

Required:

- **port** (String) Switch port name in 'port@switch' format (e.g. 'swp10@leaf-01').

Optional:

- **untagged** (Boolean) Add the port as an untagged (access mode) member. Default true.
